I rent this barley plot, so I must be careful with my money — but barley is my main crop here and I need a good harvest to pay the rent and feed my family. I will buy some DAP and a little urea like most of us do in Oromia, but not the full recommended amount because fertilizer is expensive and the rains can fail. I kept some seed from last year's harvest, so I will plant that local variety I trust, and my wife and older children will help me with weeding and harvest to save on hired labor. I cannot irrigate — I depend on the belg and meher rains like everyone in my kebele.
